# Fieldnotes

A small notes REST API.

## Getting started / 安装启动
Requires Node.js 24 or newer.
Run `node src/server.js` to start on port 3000.
Run `node --test` to execute tests.

## Architecture / 架构
src/server.js is the HTTP entry point.
src/router.js dispatches GET /notes and POST /notes.
src/store.js keeps notes in memory; restarting clears them.

## API
GET /notes returns all notes.
POST /notes accepts JSON with a non-empty title.
Authentication and persistence are not implemented.

# Contributing / 贡献

1. Read README.md and follow the request flow from server to router to store.
2. Add a node:test case before changing behavior.
3. Run node --test.
4. Keep pull requests focused.

Good first task: add a health check route GET /health in src/router.js.
Expected behavior: HTTP 200 with JSON {"status":"ok"}.
Add a test for the new route and existing 404 behavior.
